tools.name: sites
tools.description: Lists the live sites of every team the caller belongs to, each with its team, scope hosts, verification state, and review agreement state. `team` limits the list to one team, by slug. A site's `host` is what the review and runs tools take.

tools.name: review
tools.description: Requests today's run of a site and returns it. A site gets one run per UTC day: the first request that day creates it as `queued` with `created: true`, and every later request that day returns the same run in its current status with `created: false`. Requires the owner or admin role in the site's te

tools.name: runs
tools.description: Lists a site's 30 newest runs, newest UTC day first, each with its status, mode, and tier. An earlier run that crawled the site also lists its coverage, risk counts, scores, and versions; a run whose report an AI agent wrote has none of those. `before` pages to runs older than that UTC day.

tools.name: listIssues
tools.description: Lists the issues found in one UTC month on the sites of every team the caller is a member of: the findings of each run report of that month, by day, then site, then their order in the report, each with its day, host, site ID, run ID, finding ID, section, title, and label. `month` is YYYY-MM and defa

tools.name: listLatestIssues
tools.description: Lists the issues of the newest run report of each site of every team the caller is a member of, each with its day, host, site ID, run ID, finding ID, section, title, and label. A site whose newest report has no finding adds no issue. `team` names one team by slug and answers 403 when the caller is n

tools.name: report
tools.description: Returns a run's report. For a run whose report an AI agent wrote, it returns that document with every section. For an earlier run that crawled the site, it returns the status, coverage, risk counts and scores by lens, pages, and risks with their evidence and fixes. `format: "md"` returns the same re

tools.name: addSite
tools.description: Adds a site at a host, such as example.com, and returns the three proofs that can verify it: a DNS TXT record, a meta tag on the home page, and a file under `/.well-known/`. A team holds one site, so a team that already has a live site gets 409 `team_has_site`. A site belongs to one team at a time,

tools.name: readSiteVerification
tools.description: Reads the site's verification: the method that last verified it, when, and the three proofs, any one of which verifies it. Any member of the site's team may read it.

tools.name: confirmSiteVerification
tools.description: Checks for one method's proof now: `dns_txt` resolves the TXT record directly, and `meta_tag` and `well_known_file` read the page through Firecrawl. A proof that is found verifies the site by that method, and a missing one gets 409 `proof_not_found` and changes nothing. Riskcovery checks for the sam

tools.name: deleteSite
tools.description: Deletes the site, which frees its host for any team and stops all further runs. Requires the owner or admin role.

tools.name: readAgreement
tools.description: Reads the site's review agreement: the newest accepted one, still in force or since revoked, with its signer, stated role, time, scope, and version hash, and the current terms with their version hash, which an acceptance must name. Any member of the site's team may read it.

tools.name: acceptAgreement
tools.description: Accepts the review agreement for a verified site as the caller, and records the caller's address, the role they state, the time, and the version hash, which must be the current one. Acceptance starts the daily schedule: today's run is created and requested at once, and each later UTC day brings one

tools.name: revokeAgreement
tools.description: Revokes the site's accepted review agreement, with an optional reason. A queued or running run of the site is cancelled at once and its machine is deleted, and the site gets no more runs until an agreement is accepted again. Requires the owner or admin role.

tools.name: listShareLinks
tools.description: Lists the run's share links, newest first, each marked live, expired, or revoked, with who created it and when it expires. A link's token is shown only when the link is created. Any member of the run's team may read it.

tools.name: createShareLink
tools.description: Creates a link that shows the run's full report to anyone who has it, with no account needed, until the link is revoked or expires after 1, 7 (the default), or 30 days. The link is returned only in this response. Requires the owner or admin role.

tools.name: revokeShareLink
tools.description: Revokes one of the run's share links, so it stops showing the report at once. Revoking a link that is already revoked or expired leaves it revoked. Requires the owner or admin role.

tools.name: listTeams
tools.description: Lists the teams the caller is a member of, oldest first, each with its slug, its name, and the role of the caller in it: owner, admin, or member.

tools.name: createTeam
tools.description: Creates a team named by `name`, which is trimmed and holds 1 to 80 characters, with the caller as its owner, and answers 201 with its slug, which the other team operations take. `eligibility`, either `nonprofit` or `small_business`, asks for the free plan for the team while the free plan is open.

tools.name: teamDeletionLink
tools.description: Answers `url`, the delete page of the team, where its owner, signed in, deletes the team with its site, runs, reports, share links, and invitations, which ends its subscription and removes its members. Only the owner gets the link, so another member gets 403.

tools.name: listMemberInvitations
tools.description: Lists the pending member invitations of the team, newest first, each with the invited address, its role, and when it was sent and expires, with the seats the team holds and has taken. Needs the owner or admin role.

tools.name: memberInvitationsLink
tools.description: Answers `url`, the member invitations page of the team, where a signed-in owner or admin invites an address as an `admin` or `member`, which mails it a link to accept that expires after 14 days, and revokes a pending invitation. `email` and `role` fill in the invite form. Needs the owner or admin ro

tools.name: readInvitation
tools.description: Reads the invitation that the id from its mail link names: the team, the invited address, its role, whether that address has an account, and whether the invitation is pending, accepted, expired, or revoked, with `url`, its page, where the invited address, signed in, accepts it.

tools.name: readTeamBilling
tools.description: Reads the billing of the team: its subscription with its plan and dates, its free plan eligibility, the seats it holds and has taken, whether its site is verified, and its runs this month by mode. Any member reads it.

tools.name: billingLink
tools.description: Answers `url`, the billing page of the team, where a signed-in owner or admin picks a plan through Stripe Checkout or opens the Stripe billing portal for the payment method, invoices, and subscription. Any member gets the link.

tools.name: listPlans
tools.description: Lists the plans a team subscribes to, each with its name and its price in US cents, or answers `plans` as null while the prices cannot be read.

tools.name: listApiKeys
tools.description: Lists the API keys of the caller, newest first, each with its name, the first characters of the key, and when it was created. A key itself is shown only when it is created. An OAuth access token gets 403.

tools.name: createApiKey
tools.description: Creates an API key that acts as the caller on this API, the CLI, and the MCP server, named by `name`, which is trimmed and holds 1 to 32 characters. The key is returned only in this response. An OAuth access token gets 403, so an agent cannot create a key that outlives its grant.

tools.name: revokeApiKey
tools.description: Revokes an API key of the caller, so a request carrying it gets 401 from then on. A key the caller does not hold answers 404. An OAuth access token gets 403.

tools.name: readRunEmail
tools.description: Reads whether the caller gets run mail, `on`, `off`, or `default`, which sends it for each team where the caller is an owner or admin, and the address it goes to.

tools.name: setRunEmail
tools.description: Sets whether the caller gets run mail to `on`, `off`, or `default`, which sends it for each team where the caller is an owner or admin, and answers the setting.

tools.name: reportProblem
tools.description: Sends a problem report of `message`, which holds 1 to 4,000 characters, to the people who run this service, with `from`, the path of the page it is about, when given. A caller who sends too many reports gets 429.

tools.name: listCves
tools.description: Lists the published records of the CVE List, newest first, 50 to a page, each with its CVE ID, when it was published, its CVSS score and severity when it has one, and its title or the start of its description, with the total, the number of pages, and the page shown. `query` holds up to 200 character

tools.name: readCve
tools.description: Reads the record of the CVE List that `cveId` names, in any letter case: its state, title, and description, when it was reserved, published, and updated, its CVSS score and severity when it has one, its metrics, weaknesses, affected products and versions, and references. An ID the CVE List does not

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: sites, review, readAgreement · Private data: report, addSite, confirmSiteVerification, acceptAgreement, listShareLinks, listApiKeys, createApiKey, revokeApiKey, listCves, readCve · Public sink: listShareLinks, revokeShareLink, teamDeletionLink, memberInvitationsLink · Destructive: review, runs, listIssues, listLatestIssues, report, confirmSiteVerification, acceptAgreement, revokeAgreement, listShareLinks, createShareLink, revokeShareLink, teamDeletionLink, readRunEmail, setRunEmail, reportProblem.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: sites, review, readAgreement · Private data: report, addSite, confirmSiteVerification, acceptAgreement, listShareLinks, listApiKeys, createApiKey, revokeApiKey, listCves, readCve · Public sink: listShareLinks, revokeShareLink, teamDeletionLink, memberInvitationsLink · Destructive: review, runs, listIssues, listLatestIssues, report, confirmSiteVerification, acceptAgreement, revokeAgreement, listShareLinks, createShareLink, revokeShareLink, teamDeletionLink, readRunEmail, setRunEmail, reportProblem

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
